body.summary: Measure full managed cold/warm/history-growth workloads, build shipped package and document coordinated restart plus explicitly authorized post-deployment smoke.
acceptanceChecks: Three cold-run median<=120s, warm<=10s, controlled admit/cancel<=2s and progress observation<=2s; report all metrics; failed gates block old qualification; deployment awaits BUILD approval.
Task completion uses local managed qualification and package checks only. Deployment smoke requires later approved BUILD, user update/restart and explicit permission to retrigger original review.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Managed cold x3/warm/history-growth performance gates on supported Node/native package, npm build plus source-free package smoke; no deployed daemon mutation.
